name: World clock
author: Alfie
description: What time it is anywhere in the world, converting a time between cities ("3pm in London is what in Tokyo?"), and finding a meeting time that suits several places. Works offline with your computer's own time zone data.

tools.name: time_in
tools.description: The current date and time in one or more places. Accepts city names (Tokyo, New York, Sydney…), countries with one time zone, or IANA zones like Europe/Paris.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a date and time in one place to other places, e.g. 15:00 in London to Tokyo and Los Angeles.

tools.name: meeting_times
tools.description: Hours of a day that fall inside working hours (default 09:00–18:00) in every place given.

prompt: Use these tools for any question about the time in another place or converting between time zones, rather than working out offsets yourself (daylight saving makes that error-prone).
